schema.text: Do you rarely cycle because the places you go are too far or cycling takes too long?

ar.#Do you rarely cycle because the places: هل تعود قلّة ركوبك الدراجة إلى أن وجهاتك بعيدة جدًا أو أن الطريق بالدراجة يستغرق وقتًا طويلًا؟

de.#Do you rarely cycle because the places: Fahren Sie selten Rad, weil Ihre Ziele zu weit entfernt sind oder der Weg mit dem Rad zu lange dauert?

en.#Do you rarely cycle because the places: Do you rarely cycle because the places you go are too far or cycling takes too long?

fa.#Do you rarely cycle because the places: آیا کم دوچرخه‌سواری می‌کنید چون مقصدهایتان خیلی دور است یا با دوچرخه خیلی طول می‌کشد؟

fr.#Do you rarely cycle because the places: Faites-vous rarement du vélo parce que les lieux où vous allez sont trop loin ou que le trajet à vélo prend trop de temps ?

hu.#Do you rarely cycle because the places: Azért kerékpározik ritkán, mert az úti céljai túl messze vannak, vagy kerékpárral túl sokáig tart az út?

it.#Do you rarely cycle because the places: Vai poco in bici perché i posti dove vai sono troppo lontani o in bici ci vuole troppo tempo?

tr.#Do you rarely cycle because the places: Gittiğiniz yerler çok uzak olduğu ya da bisikletle gitmek çok uzun sürdüğü için mi nadiren bisiklet sürüyorsunuz?
